name: genpire
description: Design products in your Genpire account from Claude: create a product from a description or an idea, change or redraw it, compare three options, apply your brand style, make a size guide, specs or a tech pack, try colours and Pantone matches, make moodboards, print files and Studio images, and prepare a factory quote request. Uses your existing Genpire plan; usage is shown as a percentage. Built and powered by Genpire.
